transactions.property_name: Lippo Plaza Shanghai (via Lippo Realty (Shanghai) Limited)
transactions.counterparty: Unrelated third-party purchaser (buyer entity not named; deal executed via SPA for the shares in Lippo Realty (Shanghai) Limited, sold through indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Tecwell Pte. Ltd.)
transactions.citation: p181, Note 30 'Disposal of a subsidiary': 'On 20 December 2024, the Group announced the divestment of 100% issued and paid-up capital of Lippo Realty (Shanghai) Limited ... for a total sales consideration of RMB 1,916,925,000 (equivalent to approximately $357,382,000). The sale was completed on 27 December 2024.' Same note, cash-flow effect-of-disposal table: 'Investment property 311,136' ($'000).
transactions.notes: PROPERTY-LEVEL economics (this is what the five required fields capture): gross sale consideration S$357,382,000 vs the disposed Lippo Realty (Shanghai) Limited's investment-property carrying value S$311,136,000 (both from Note 30, p181) = DERIVED premium of +14.86% ((357,382-311,136)/311,136). No independent third-party valuation of the property itself is disclosed in this AR (only an 'agreed property value' of RMB1,680.0m/S$313.2m is mentioned in the Manager's commentary, line 945 -- using that as reference_value would give (357,382-313,200)/313,200=+14.11%, a close but distinct alternative; the audited carrying-value figure is used as the primary reference per spec preference for audited-statement sourcing). *** ACCOUNTING LOSS DIFFERS IN SIGN FROM THE PROPERTY-LEVEL FIGURE ABOVE -- DO NOT CONFLATE ***: the Statements of Total Return records a LOSS on disposal of the subsidiary of S$(26,427,000) (Note 30, p181 cash-flow reconciliation: 'Loss on disposal of a subsidiary (26,427)'). This accounting loss is NOT a property-level loss -- it results from SUBSIDIARY-level (equity-disposal) accounting: the Note 30 table shows 'Net asset disposed 325,240' (investment property 311,136 + other net assets, net of deferred/current tax liabilities on the SPV), then ADDS BACK a S$54,614,000 transfer of accumulated foreign-currency-translation-reserve (FCTR) to the statement of total return (a non-cash recycling of historical RMB/SGD FX losses accumulated over the ~decade OUE REIT held the asset) and DEDUCTS a S$32,323,000 disposal tax expense (assessed at 10% of sales consideration less cost of investment recorded, plus transaction costs incl. S$1,566,000 divestment fee), netting to the reported S$(26,427,000) loss. In short: the PROPERTY sold at a premium to its carrying value (+14.86%, a gain), but the SUBSIDIARY-DISPOSAL accounting loss is negative because it additionally captures ~S$54.6m of recycled FX reserve and ~S$32.3m of disposal tax that have nothing to do with the property's price-vs-book economics -- the sign flip (property gain vs. consolidated-statement loss) is a real accounting-mechanics artifact, not an error. Net cash inflow on disposal was S$299,460,000 (after deferred consideration and cash/withholding-tax adjustments, same note). Independent valuation by Savills (Guangzhou) dated 18 Dec 2024 was RMB1,769.0m (~S$329.8m) (line 1977) -- lower than the sale consideration, so the property also sold at a premium to that independent valuation: (357,382-329,800)/329,800 = +8.36% (also positive/gain), reinforcing that the property-level transaction was a gain across every basis (carrying value, agreed property value, and independent valuation) except the FCTR/tax-laden subsidiary-disposal accounting loss line. CROSS-YEAR NOTE: this identical deal also appears in TS0U_FY2025.json (comparative/audit-trail context in the FY2025 AR); deal_id 'ts0u:lippo_plaza_shanghai:divestment:2024' is IDENTICAL and deliberately matched across both files per spec's cross-year-duplicate rule.
